name: pxe-proxy
title: PXE Proxy (proxyDHCP)
description: proxyDHCP sidecar for netboot.xyz — answers PXE clients with a boot filename when the router cannot set DHCP options 66/67. Does NOT hand out IP addresses. Requires dnsmasq.conf in App-Data/PXE-Proxy (pre-seeded for this LAN); edit the dhcp-range if the subnet changes.
